scope: Finite primary-source check of GNEX/GVM on Windows CE, Pocket PC and Palm, including exact Samsung MITs/SCH-M450/SPH-M4500, i-series, LG KC1 and Cyberbank candidates.
conclusion: No actual shipped GNEX/GVM model on Windows CE/PocketPC/Palm was established in this branch; no CAB, ARM EXE, runtime or game for these OS families was recovered.

sources.kind: Manufacturer product announcement, exact live HTML response preserved
sources.observation: Actual product body names SPH-M4500, PDA/office functions, WiFi, DMB and a planned SKT SCH-M450 variant. It does not establish GNEX/GVM or a WinCE runtime download.
sources.dateResolution: Unresolved anomaly. Retained verbatim; not accepted as a verified release date, corrected by guesswork or used to date GNEX support.
sources.cdxDigestReason: Live HTTPS source response, not a Wayback replay.

sources.kind: Manufacturer-authored manual text hosted by third-party mirror; original PDF not obtained
sources.observation: The games section explicitly lists 카드놀이 and Bubble Breaker under the ordinary Programs/Games menu. Text-find returned no GNEX, GVM, WIPI or 위피 matches.
sources.limits: No match in extracted/OCR text does not prove the firmware lacks a VM. The game names do not establish SGS packaging or native binary identity.
sources.shellOutcome: HTTP403 HTML body saved only as local transport diagnostic; not bundled as a manual or original source.

sources.kind: Previously recovered 262-page research report; root owns original preservation package
sources.observation: Distinguishes current GNEX-on-SKT-WIPI from proposals to put WIPI on Symbian/Windows CE. Names Samsung, LG and Cyberbank as Windows Mobile PocketPC vendors without specifying models or demonstrating a GNEX runtime on them.
sources.coverage: Whole-file keyword search performed; only physical page252 text and rendered page were specifically reviewed here. This is not a full new visual review of262pages.

sources.kind: Distributor catalog read through web tool; raw response not preserved
sources.observation: The generic site navigation advertises PocketPC and Palm. All five listed Sinjisoft products explicitly state Symbian Series60 v6/v7/v8: World League2005 Soccer, Storm of Silence, Bounce!, Waterski and Aiolos Fighter. This is not evidence of WinCE/Palm releases.
Search snippets mention Cyberbank/PocketPC in platform context. Neither web tool nor raw request obtained the PDF; no model or GNEX support is asserted from the snippet.

baselineEvidence.status: Existing repository source describes WinCE demonstrations without exact models; retained as demonstrations, not a newly recovered shipped product or runtime. No duplicate FAIR2005 branch or archive packaging.

limits: No known device or OS support was inferred merely from WIPI, Java, ARM PE, general vendor relationships, generic catalog navigation, planned PDA ports or a matching game title.
No original CAB, WinCE ARM.EXE, GNEX runtime or game was found; runtime compatibility was not tested.
No failed Wayback/publisher endpoints from the preceding branch were retried.
No login, credentials, private gate, author contact, vendor code, Office macro, installer or firmware execution used.

Samsung HTML was reread locally: byte length and SHA256 match the HTTP receipt; expected title/product body and literal metadata are present. HTML text counts are limited static checks, not a firmware audit.
Shared repository/index/catalog/Git files were not modified.
